caption: kiryu vs the dragon of osaka - the kamurocho-to-soutenbori sequel, dug for pcsx2.
about: Yakuza 2 (2006) is the dragon of kansai chapter: kiryu's truce breaks with ryuji goda's ambition, the story splits between kamurocho and osaka's soutenbori, and the beat-em-up combat deepens with weapons, walls and the series' first proper rival-dragon duel. The substory density and the love-and-honor melodrama set the template every later entry runs on.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
